name: Trim Prime from Factory-Primed - QT3, Brush
_demonstration_note: Same modules as SCN_TRIM_PRIME_FROM_BARE but with substrate_condition=factory_primed in the ctx. The MOD_APPLY_TRIM_PRIME_BRUSH module's MDF edge seal task and knot spot prime task both gate by substrate_condition, so they will SKIP automatically in this scenario. Net effect: factory-primed gets a single coat of brush primer with no edge sealing or spot priming overhead. This is the substrate-state branching demonstration — same modules, different starting state, different work expressed via task-level applies_when.
